attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin copies the briefing's section labels ('News since your last bulletin:', 'Already reported:') straight into the text, which breaks character. It also reuses the earlier bulletin's line almost word for word ('a great deal of resolve. It is not clear which of these will last longest'). The governorship item is thin, though the 'eviction notices' line has some of the right dry bite."}
